# Kevin Bravo

> Kevin Bravo (0bkevin) is a product and AI engineer based in Caracas, Venezuela, with 5+ years building full-stack products, AI agents, and the tooling around them for startups, nonprofits, and government-commissioned programs. He owns products end to end, from the first conversation with users to production and the support after launch.

This file is a navigation aid for AI agents. Crawler permissions are defined in robots.txt.
For everything in one file (profile, full work history, bio, AMA, and case studies), read
https://kevinbravo.com/llms-full.txt. Links ending in `.md` are plain Markdown copies of pages;
drop the `.md` for the HTML page.

## Key facts

- Name: Kevin Bravo, also known online as 0bkevin.
- Title: Product & AI Engineer (product engineering, AI engineering, full-stack, backend).
- Location: Caracas, Venezuela.
- Most recent role: Senior Product Engineer at Free2Z (March 2025 to October 2026). Led the live creator platform's migration from React to SvelteKit and built an MCP server that lets AI agents publish and manage content through scoped, expiring access.
- Earlier: Product Engineer for the U.S. Department of State's Venezuela Affairs Unit (via AVAA), leading Billingua Talent; Full Stack Engineer at AVAA, where he built SEP (about 400 monthly users across three chapters) with a LangChain RAG assistant, and SEA for EducationUSA advisors.
- Current focus: AI tooling and agentic systems, including MCP servers, LangGraph pipelines, and tools for working with AI agents.
- Education: Occupational Therapy, Universidad Central de Venezuela (cum laude, 2023); Master of Public Administration at IESA (in progress).
- Honors: 2nd place, AI Security track, Platanus Hack Caracas (2026); 3rd place, EmprendeTECH Hackathon at IESA (2025).
- Contact: 0bravokevin@gmail.com or https://kevinbravo.com/contact

## Projects (external)

- viamu (https://viamu.app): Free catalog of scholarships, internships, and fellowships, kept current by an AI pipeline.
- Registro CiberVE (https://registrociberve.com): Bilingual public registry of cybersecurity incidents tied to Venezuela.
- Arena Criolla (https://arenacriolla.com): Open source multiplayer fighting game starring iconic characters from Venezuelan culture.
- Brio (https://github.com/0bkevin/brio): Phone app for talking to a Hermes AI agent from anywhere.
- Cinve (https://github.com/0bkevin/cinve): MCP server for Venezuelan cinema listings, showtimes, prices, and seat availability.
